name: PIX Batch-Scale Processing Doctrine
problem_statement: The Sprint 01 proof chain is too slow to repeat manually for hundreds of PIX.
core_rule: Do not process 300 PIX one-by-one through full manual doctrine steps. Use the proven spine as a reusable batch pipeline.

batch_first_rule.method: batch classify, score, triage, and queue
batch_first_rule.full_catalog_goal: all reasonable GPMC PIX and KKs

manual_deep_review_required_when: candidate is considered for buyer-facing public promotion
theme is grief, apology, trauma, medical, crisis, or high-risk repair
lyrics or context could pressure, manipulate, shame, or overpromise
candidate may become a flagship K-KUT, mK, GPMD, or public package anchor

public_safety_law.not_public: Internal candidates may exist in quantity.
public_safety_law.approve_internal: Internal readiness only; no route, no Stripe, no buyer exposure.
public_safety_law.approved_public: Only this status may enter buyer-facing pages, Stripe-backed offers, public HUG flow, or promotion.

inventory_targets.full_catalog_direction: batch toward abundance across all commercially useful themes

income_rule: Platform spine exists to support income. Batch inventory must prioritize sellable lanes first: birthday, encouragement/support, friendship, gratitude, romance, anniversary, wedding, apology, KUPID, family/parent, mentor.
locked_summary: Use the Sprint 01 spine as a reusable batch machine. Do not repeat one-song or one-PIX marathons across 300 PIX.
